item.name: Arrow of Acid

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, this ammunition explodes, dealing {@dice 2d4} acid damage to all creatures within 10 feet of the target. The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition Melting|Starlight} until the end of your next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Fire

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, this ammunition explodes, dealing {@dice 2d4} fire damage to all creatures within 10 feet of the target. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Burning|Starlight}, repeating the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

item.name: Arrow of Ice

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, this ammunition explodes, dealing {@dice 2d4} cold damage to all creatures within 10 feet of the target. The target is {@condition Hampered|Starlight} until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Lightning

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, this ammunition explodes, dealing {@dice 2d4} lightning damage to all creatures within 10 feet of the target. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Shocked|Starlight} until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Thunder

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, this ammunition explodes, dealing {@dice 2d4} thunder damage to all creatures within 10 feet of the target. Any creature who takes this thunder damage must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be thrown 10 feet away from the target (the target is pushed directly away from you).
Huge or larger creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this saving throw.

item.name: Arrow of Gravity

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, the ammunition explodes, and all creatures within 15 feet of the target must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet towards the target. If they cannot be moved the full 10 feet, they fall {@condition Prone|xphb} as well. On a failed save, the target is {@condition Slowed|Starlight}, and cannot jump, until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Piercing

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, the arrow deals half the damage of the original hit to the nearest creature up to 10 feet directly behind the original target.

item.name: Arrow of Binding

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, the target must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or become {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by spectral ropes until the end of your next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Wounding

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, causes the target to {@condition Bleeding|Starlight|Bleed}. At the end of each of their turns, they can make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw to end the condition.

item.name: Arrow of Maiming

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the start of your next turn. On a successful saving throw, they are {@condition Slowed|Starlight} instead.

item.name: Arrow of Curing

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, this ammunition deals no damage, and instead clears the targets of any of the following conditions: {@condition Blinded|xphb}, {@condition Poisoned|xphb}, {@condition Paralysed|xphb}, {@condition Deafened|xphb}, {@condition Dazed|Starlight}, {@condition Disoriented|Starlight}, {@condition Weakened|Starlight}, {@condition Bleeding|Starlight}, {@condition Burning|Starlight}, {@condition Melting|Starlight}, {@condition Brittle|Starlight}, or {@condition Shocked|Starlight}.

item.name: Arrow of Disruption

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, the target loses {@status Concentration|XPHB} on any spell they are maintaining. Additionally, they must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Silenced|Starlight} until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Darkness

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, you cast the {@spell Darkness|xphb} spell on the target or target location. It lasts the full duration, not requiring concentration.

item.name: Arrow of Revealing

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, the target becomes outlined in a glowing light, shedding {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 5-foot radius. This outline is visible through up to 10 feet of solid material, and lasts for 1 minute. While lit up this way, the target cannot benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition.

item.name: Arrow of Dazzling

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, the arrow emits a flash of light. The target takes an additional {@dice 1d4} radiant damage and must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Lesser Slaying

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
If this arrow hits a Beast, Monstrosity, Undead, Humanoid, Construct, or Aberration, the attack is a critical hit.

item.name: Arrow of Weeping

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, the target takes an additional {@dice 1d4} necrotic damage and cannot regain any hit points until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Greater Slaying

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
If this arrow hits a Dragon, Celestial, Elemental, Fiend, or Fey, the attack is a critical hit.

item.name: Arrow of Recurving

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

Hit or miss, you can make an attack against another target within 30 feet of the target (you cannot choose the same target more than once per arrow). You can do this up to two times, and you do not add your ability modifier to the damage roll of the additional attack(s).

item.name: Arrow of Relocation

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
You teleport to where this arrow lands.

item.name: Arrow of Explosives

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

Hit or miss, this arrow explodes, forcing all creatures within 10 feet of the target to make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed saving throw, they take {@dice 4d4} fire damage and {@dice 4d4} force damage. On a successful saving throw, they take half the damage.
